messages.subject: Custom Searching in DataTable
parts:
How can I implement case-insensitive searching in a Data Tables table? I've tried passing different options, but as search/sort/pagination are done server-side, I don't think they do anything.

Since I also want to do some more complex things with custom search in the future, I've been looking at renderDataTable()'s source code to try and understand when exactly the searching is made, but I'm not getting it. At which point does Shiny choose the (usually) ten rows that are sent to the javascript side and displayed to the user?

messages.author: e6d426c9552b1af9
messages.subject: Custom Searching in DataTable
parts:
If you can't fix it in JavaScript you could also position additional search fields with renderUI based on existing Shiny components e.g a text input field, write some basic r code that does what you want e.g sort or filter the data and regenerate the table in the browser. Obviously better solutions exist, but in need it will work :-)

Best Herman

messages.subject: Re: Custom Searching in DataTable
parts:
The last time I checked DataTables, it still did not have a
configuration option to specify whether searching should be
case-sensitive or not. An awkward solution is to type both upper and
lower cases in the search field, e.g. if you want to search for Apple,
you may use [Aa][Pp][Pp][Ll][Ee].

I'm going to work on the latest version of DataTables (1.10) soon. If
it has added such an option, I will be happy to support it.

BTW, if you are curious about how filtering is done in shiny, you can
take a look at the function shiny:::dataTablesJSON.

Regards,
Yihui
